summary: Iter335 — Re-test SB Drive airport transfer pre-fill after the deep-link rewrite (URL-native params plat/plng/paddr + dlat/dlng/daddr with hardcoded airport coordinates in AIRPORT_PLACES). All 3 acceptance criteria PASS. (1) Click sbdrive-to-airport-fbk_ee4ba7ea84 (FDF) → URL=/course?mode=standard&dlat=14.591&dlng=-61.0032&daddr=Aéroport%20Martinique%20Aimé%20Césaire%2C%20Le%20Lamentin AND the DESTINATION area on RideChoosePage displays 'Aéroport Martinique Aimé Césaire, Le Lamentin' (ride-choose-dropoff-display). NO 'France' fallback — bug from iter334 fixed. (2) Click sbdrive-from-airport-fbk_ee4ba7ea84 (ORY) → URL=/course?mode=standard&plat=48.7233&plng=2.3794&paddr=Aéroport%20de%20Paris-Orly AND the DÉPART input (data-testid=ride-choose-pickup) value='Aéroport de Paris-Orly' — NOT overwritten by user current geolocation (autoLocate is correctly skipped when pickup is pre-filled via URL params, see RideChoosePage L233). (3) Regression: 10 confirmed Duffel bookings — exactly the 4 FDF→ORY ones (fbk_ee4ba7ea84, fbk_19729a2004, fbk_00b691fda0, fbk_c1951350f2) render sbdrive-transfer block with BOTH sbdrive-to-airport-* and sbdrive-from-airport-* buttons; the other 6 (LHR→JFK and held) render NO block. Visibility logic in SbDriveTransfer (AIRPORT_PLACES lookup) is correct.
